noah_research: quick note from this morning's spot-check: ran speculative decoding on nova-12b-int8 with two-stage rescoring. overall throughput +18%, but observed misordered bullets in technical summaries (formatting issues).

abby_infra: two-stage rescoring meaning?

noah_research: first stage speculative greedy prefill, second stage beam rescoring on final tokens using cached kvs. run: ```
./eval_harness --model nova-12b-int8 --speculative true --spec_ratio 0.3 --rescoring beam=5 --batch 4
```

lena_ml: misordered bullets sound like a decoding artifact; are list tokens being generated out of order after rescoring?

noah_research: exact. examples in artifacts: bullet item order swapped in 7/200 examples. hypothesis: kv-cache index misalignment when speculative tokens inserted across batch boundaries.

mark_prod: that's worrying for structured outputs. how about fp16 run?

noah_research: fp16+spec shows 1/200 swap. so quant exacerbates. i'm pushing a job to rerun with stricter synchronous kv flush per-request to see if it fixes.

ci-bot: queued 6 jobs 7173332233-7173332238 on cluster nova-pool. artifacts will be at https://ci.internal/runs/7173332233

abby_infra: if kv misalignment is root cause, we need a rolling fix: either ensure speculative inserts use per-request safe offsets or lock KV update ordering in the runtime. locking may hurt perf.

noah_research: agreed. preliminary perf tradeoff: locking adds ~6% latency but eliminates swaps in small local test. i can run a perf sweep.

lena_ml: also instrument token-index checksums to quickly detect misalignment in canary. add as metric.

mark_prod: propose: run shadow canary with token-index-checksum enabled for 2% traffic. if checksum mismatch rate >0.1% then route to non-spec.

ci-bot: jobs 7173332233-7173332238 completed: 6/6 succeeded. early artifacts show checksum mismatch correlates with swapped bullets. https://ci.internal/runs/7173332233/results

noah_research: based on artifacts, fix path: (1) implement per-request speculative write offset calc, (2) add checksum logging, (3) add rescoring length-bias to prefer full sentences when logit diffs small. I'll open PRs.

abby_infra: i'll prototype a runtime flag to enable strict kv-ordering for canary.

mark_prod: thanks. timeline?

noah_research: PRs by EOD, infra flag prototype in 48h, then shadow canary.

lena_ml: also recommend a small regression test: generate 100 structured-list prompts and assert token-index checksums unchanged. add to CI.

noah_research: good call. will add test and ping infra.

ci-bot: created tickets: INF-4302 (kv-ordering flag), ML-2201 (speculative regression tests).

mark_prod: solid. keep thread updated.
